# VRoid AvatarSample_C

The unmodified VRoid Project sample model is bundled for the local prototype. Its asset terms are separate from this application's source license.

- File: `src/assets/models/AvatarSample_C.vrm` (VRM 0.x)
- Source: [madjin/vrm-samples](https://github.com/madjin/vrm-samples/blob/master/vroid/stable/AvatarSample_C.vrm), which identifies the asset as a VRoid sample model.
- Embedded metadata: title `AvatarSample_C`; author `VRoid`; allowed user `Everyone`; commercial use allowed. The original VRM 0.x metadata uses `licenseName: Other`; the applicable usage conditions are the official sample model terms linked below.
- Conditions: [VRoid AvatarSample A–Z](https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/ja/articles/4402394424089-AvatarSample-A-Z)

This model is not CC0. Do not imply pixiv endorsement, relabel it as CC0, or redistribute the model file for a fee without a valid reason. Review the linked conditions before redistributing this application.
